explication: Immersive Language Learning is a browser-based roleplay practice app backed by a FastAPI service and Gemini Live. A learner moves from the welcome screen to choosing a mission, languages, and a learning mode, then practices in a live audio conversation and receives a completion score and feedback. The browser streams media through the service to Gemini and renders conversation updates. The README also describes optional bot protection, rate limiting, and BigQuery metrics. Some backend and UI excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal connections are omitted.
